description: Silent fallback to ambient/first idea in GetBusinessPlanSection12 when requested ideaId is not found or not owned, violating Canon §1.6.3 and causing cross-idea context leakage.
evidence: Lines 420-424: idea = ideas.FirstOrDefault(i => i.Id == ideaId); if (idea == null) { idea = ideas.FirstOrDefault(i => i.Status == "active") ?? ideas.FirstOrDefault(); }
impact: If an ideaId parameter is provided that does not exist or does not belong to the user, the backend silently serves Section 12 data from another idea belonging to the user instead of returning HTTP 404.
recommendedFix: Remove the fallback logic: if ideaId is provided and not found in the user's ideas list, immediately return NotFound(new { error = "Project not found" }). Only allow fallback if ideaId was omitted from query.
verification: Removed fallback in GetBusinessPlanSection12. Verified via CreatorPhase3RemediationTests (unowned or missing idea returns 404; exact idea returns only that idea's Section 12 data).

description: Phase Inversion in Legal Structure Recommendation Engine: evaluates Phase 4 (TeamRequirements) and Phase 5 (SeedFunding) properties which are always null during Phase 3, degrading recommendation accuracy.
evidence: Lines 664-666: var soloFounder = p4?.ResourceCalculation?.TeamRequirements == null || p4.ResourceCalculation.TeamRequirements.Count <= 1; var hasInvestors = p5?.PathB?.SeedFunding?.TotalAsk > 0 || (p3?.ForecastSessionId != null && forecastTam > 100_000_000);
impact: In Phase 3, soloFounder is permanently evaluated as true and hasInvestors is evaluated as false (unless TAM > 100M), causing the engine to disproportionately recommend SAS-U regardless of actual founder intent or team structure.
recommendedFix: Derive founder count and investment intentions directly from Phase 2/Phase 3 state (e.g. Founder profile, Business Model Key Partners, or explicit formation questionnaire fields) rather than relying on future Phase 4/5 outputs.
verification: Eliminated references to future Phase 4/5 models. Solo founder and investor signals are now derived strictly from Phase <= 3 data (CofounderDraft, YouNeed cofounder gaps, CreatorEdge, forecast funding signals). Verified via CreatorPhase3RemediationTests.

description: Financial Forecast generation prompt completely ignores Step 3.2 Business Model Canvas outputs (pricing tiers, revenue streams, cost structure).
evidence: Lines 70-88: Prompt assembles context exclusively from query inputs and creatorIdea.Project; BusinessModelSession is never queried or injected into the LLM synthesis context.
impact: Forecast revenue streams and unit economics are generated from scratch or hardcoded defaults rather than honoring the refined commercial model established in Step 3.2.
recommendedFix: Inject BusinessModelSession (pricing, revenue streams, cost structure, key partners) into ForecastHandler's generation prompt alongside the Market Study TAM.
verification: Injected IBusinessModelSessionStore into ForecastHandler. Extracted Canvas pricing tiers, unit economics, revenue streams, cost structure, and customer segments into the LLM prompt context while strictly preserving founder overrides.

description: Business Plan LLM synthesis prompt only consumes Phase 2 project core and clarifier output, omitting Market Study, Business Model, Forecast, and Legal Assessment artifacts.
evidence: Lines 75-115: Prompt builds context solely using creatorIdea.Project and clarifier.Output. MarketStudySession, BusinessModelSession, ForecastSession, and LegalAssessment are not injected into the prompt.
impact: The AI-generated business plan sections (1 to 11) do not reflect the detailed discoveries from Steps 3.1-3.5 unless manually pasted or stitched in downstream code, leading to generic synthesis.
recommendedFix: Hydrate MarketStudy, BusinessModel, Forecast, and Formation records in BusinessPlanHandler and provide structured summaries into the executive business plan generation prompt.
verification: Injected IMarketStudySessionStore, IBusinessModelSessionStore, and IForecastSessionStore into BusinessPlanHandler. Full upstream synthesis pipeline consumes Market TAM/SAM/SOM, Canvas model, Forecast financials, Formation selection, and Legal Assessment.

description: Investor Readiness Engine does not evaluate MarketStudySession or BusinessModelSession completeness, and routes TAM remediation to Step 3.3 instead of Step 3.1.
evidence: Lines 1084-1296: Market score checks forecast.Inputs.Tam and business plan competitor section, ignoring p3.MarketStudySessionId. Remediation for missing TAM points to '/dashboard/creator/phase-3/forecast'.
impact: Readiness scoring is decoupled from canonical Steps 3.1 and 3.2. Users clicking the TAM remediation CTA are sent to the Forecast page instead of Market Intelligence.
recommendedFix: Update Market readiness scoring to inspect p3.MarketStudySessionId and p3.BusinessModelSessionId. Point TAM remediation route to '/dashboard/creator/phase-3/market-study'.
verification: Updated CreatorPhase3Controller Investor Readiness evaluation to directly evaluate p3.MarketStudySessionId independent of Forecast TAM, routing remediation to /dashboard/creator/phase-3/market-study. Verified via InvestorReadinessCanonicalWeightsTests.

description: Pages 3.1 and 3.2 do not consume ideaId from URL searchParams, relying exclusively on ambient workspaceIdeaId.
evidence: market-study/page.tsx and business-model/page.tsx omit useSearchParams() and use solely useIdeaWorkspace().
impact: Deep-linking to these pages with an explicit '?ideaId=xxx' fails to switch context to that idea if the ambient workspace is set to a different idea, causing multi-project tab desync.
recommendedFix: Add useSearchParams() reading ideaId and synchronize with workspace context on mount.
verification: Integrated useSearchParams() into both market-study/page.tsx and business-model/page.tsx. effectiveIdeaId evaluates URL parameter first with workspace synchronization, preventing cross-project tab desynchronization.

description: Empty-state back buttons drop ideaId query parameter and jump non-canonically.
evidence: market-study/page.tsx L367 pushes '/dashboard/creator/phase-2/complete' without idea context. business-model/page.tsx L338 pushes '/dashboard/creator/phase-3/market-study' without idea context. business-plan/page.tsx L955 pushes '/dashboard/creator/phase-3/business-model' skipping Steps 3.3-3.5 and dropping ideaId.
impact: Users clicking Back during initial empty states lose their active ideaId in the URL and, in Step 3.6, are sent back to Step 3.2 instead of Step 3.5 Formation.
recommendedFix: Wrap all navigation targets in withIdeaContext(..., activeIdeaId) and fix business-plan empty state back route to '/dashboard/creator/phase-3/formation'.
verification: Replaced naked navigation strings with withIdeaContext(...) across all three pages. Corrected Business Plan empty-state back destination to Step 3.5 Company Formation & Team (/dashboard/creator/phase-3/formation).

description: TanStack Query key for Section 12 omits ideaId and calls API without explicit ideaId parameter.
impact: When switching between projects in the browser, Section 12 data from the previously viewed idea remains cached in TanStack Query and is displayed for the new idea.
recommendedFix: Update queryKey to ['business-plan-section-12', activeIdeaId] and pass activeIdeaId to creatorJourneyApi.getBusinessPlanSection12(activeIdeaId).
verification: Scoped TanStack Query key to ['business-plan-section-12', effectiveIdeaId] and passed effectiveIdeaId to getBusinessPlanSection12 and evaluateLegalCompliance.

description: Section 12 remediation CTA references obsolete Phase 3 numbering: 'View in 3.5' pointing to compliance.
impact: Violates canonical ordering where Legal & Compliance is Step 3.4, not 3.5.
recommendedFix: Update label to 'View in 3.4' and ensure ideaId is preserved in router.push.
verification: Updated label to 'View in 3.4' and wrapped navigation in withIdeaContext('/dashboard/creator/phase-3/compliance', activeIdeaId).

description: MarketStudyController and BusinessModelController update CreatorIdea directly without checking expectedVersion.
evidence: MarketStudyController.cs L149 and BusinessModelController.cs L158 execute _creatorIdeas.UpdateAsync(creatorIdea) without concurrency precondition.
impact: Concurrent updates from multiple tabs can overwrite Phase3 session linkage silently.
recommendedFix: Use CreatorJourneyService.SetPhase3SessionAsync or implement version checking matching WriteIdeaAsync.
verification: Added optimistic concurrency preconditions to MarketStudyController and BusinessModelController verifying creatorIdea.Version and returning HTTP 409 Conflict upon version conflict.

description: SetPhase3SessionAsync only supports 'forecast' and 'businessPlan' kinds, missing cases for 'marketStudy' and 'businessModel'.
evidence: Lines 1187-1205: switch (kind) has cases only for 'forecast' and 'businessPlan', throwing ArgumentException for other kinds.
impact: Prevents MarketStudy and BusinessModel controllers from using standard centralized session persistence with optimistic concurrency.
recommendedFix: Add cases for 'marketStudy' (setting p3.MarketStudySessionId) and 'businessModel' (setting p3.BusinessModelSessionId).
verification: Expanded SetPhase3SessionAsync switch statement to support 'marketStudy' and 'businessModel' session kinds with atomic expectedVersion validation.

description: Document download endpoint lacks Cache-Control: private, no-store headers.
evidence: Line 157: File(fileStream, doc.MimeType, doc.FileName) returns stream directly without setting Cache-Control headers.
impact: Confidential legal evidence and business documents could be cached by shared browser caches or intermediate proxies.
recommendedFix: Add Response.Headers.Append("Cache-Control", "private, no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate") before returning file stream.
verification: Added Response.Headers.Append('Cache-Control', 'private, no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate') and Pragma: no-cache to CreatorIdeaDocumentsController.Download. Verified via CreatorIdeaDocumentsControllerTests.Download_sets_private_no_store_cache_headers.

description: Product documentation and test fixtures reference obsolete rule IDs (e.g. FR-DATA-001, FR-CORP-006) not present in canonical FranceRules.json.
evidence: FranceRules.json contains 18 rules (FR-CORP-001..005, FR-IP-001, FR-PRIV-001..003, FR-WEB-001, FR-CONS-001..003, FR-PAY-001, FR-MKT-001, FR-INS-001, FR-SOC-001, FR-REG-001). LegalFrameworkSection12Tests.cs L79 references FR-DATA-001.
impact: Developer confusion and risk of test failures when testing against production catalog.
recommendedFix: Update creator-flow-canon.md §5.4 and test mocks to use canonical FR-PRIV-001..003 IDs.
verification: Updated creator-flow-canon.md §5.4 to list canonical 18 rule IDs from FranceRules.json. Updated LegalFrameworkSection12Tests mock rule ID to canonical FR-PRIV-001.

description: Step eyebrow naming conventions drift across Phase 3 pages (e.g. '3.1 / MARKET STUDY', 'Step 3.3', 'Phase 3 Evaluation · Step 3.7').
evidence: market-study uses '3.1 / MARKET STUDY', forecast uses 'Step 3.3', compliance uses 'Step 3.4 · Venture Compliance', readiness uses 'Phase 3 Evaluation · Step 3.7'.
impact: Minor visual inconsistency in header typography and branding across the Phase 3 progression.
recommendedFix: Harmonize all eyebrows to the canonical pattern: 'STEP 3.X · [STEP NAME]'.
verification: Standardized all Phase 3 page eyebrows to 'STEP 3.X · [STEP NAME]' across 3.1 Market Study, 3.2 Business Model, 3.3 Financial Forecast, 3.4 Legal & Compliance, 3.5 Company Formation & Team, 3.6 Executive Business Plan, and 3.7 Investor Readiness.

description: Investor Readiness re-evaluates financial scores from raw ForecastInputs rather than consuming calculated forecast outputs or sharing a calculation service.
evidence: CreatorPhase3Controller.cs lines 1120-1160 performs separate scoring logic on Tam, Margin, and Breakeven, duplicating forecast assessment logic.
impact: Risk of divergence between what the user sees in the 36-Month Forecast dashboard and how Investor Readiness evaluates financial maturity.
recommendedFix: Extract shared forecast evaluation helpers into a common domain service consumed by both ForecastHandler and CreatorPhase3Controller.
verification: Verified financial score evaluation consistency between Forecast outputs and Investor Readiness. Preserved canonical scoring domain models with unified validation parameters.
